title: Enactment of the New York city existing building code.
officialText:
The New York city existing building code based on the 2015 edition of the International Existing Building Code published by the International Code Council, with changes that reflect the unique character of the city, is hereby adopted to read as follows:

(L.L. 2026/033, 1/17/2026, eff. 7/17/2027)
